{{Italic title}}
The '''''Siberian Mathematical Journal''''' (abbreviated as '''Sib. Math. J.''') is a cover-to-cover English translation of the [[Russian language|Russian]] [[peer-reviewed]] [[mathematics journal]] [[:ru: Сибирский математический журнал|''Sibirskii Matematicheskii Zhurnal'']], a publication of the [[:ru:Институт математики им. С.Л. Соболева|Sobolev Institute of Mathematics]] of the [[:ru:Сибирское отделение РАН|Siberian Division]] of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] ([[Novosibirsk]]). [[:ru: Сибирский математический журнал|''Sibirskii Matematicheskii Zhurnal'']] was established in 1960 and the ''Siberian Mathematical Journal'' was launched in 1966. It is published by [[Springer Science+Business Media]]. 

The journal publishes research papers in all branches of [[mathematics]], including [[functional analysis]], [[differential equation]]s, [[algebra]] and [[logic]], [[geometry]] and [[topology]], [[probability theory]] and [[mathematical statistics]], ill-posed problems of [[mathematical physics]], computational methods of [[linear algebra]], etc.

The journal is indexed in [[Russian Science Citation Index]].<ref>
